So the reason for this is that producing metadata is now done before calling ```prioritizeNodes```, while we parallelize ```buildTopologyPairToScore```, the same logic used to run in parallel with calling other priority functions, and so effectively doubling the number of threads used.

I think we can proceed for now with this PR as it is.

issue_context.title: Convert interpod affinity priority to a "map-reduce" pattern
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:

The pre-work for this is done, so converting it to map-reduce should be straightforward and includes the following steps:

1) Factor out [topologyPairToScore calculation](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/algorithm/priorities/interpod_affinity.go#L103-L211) to be run in PriorityMetadataProducer, and store the result in [priorityMetadata](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/algorithm/priorities/metadata.go#L54)


2) The [node count calculation](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/algorithm/priorities/interpod_affinity.go#L216-L219) is the map function.

3) The [score normalization logic](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/algorithm/priorities/interpod_affinity.go#L230-L242) is the reduce function. Reduce will include calculating maxCount/minCount as well.

**Why is this needed**:
This is required as a pre-request to converting it to a Score plugin.


/sig scheduling
